name: witcher-hud
description: Witcher 3 style HUD for Claude Code

plugins.name: witcher-hud
plugins.description: A Witcher 3 style HUD for Claude Code: a medallion that casts a sign for each tool, vitality for the context left, stamina for the rate limit, adrenaline for clean tool streaks, XP and levels for tokens, crowns for cost, a quest tracker for the prompt at hand, and a character sheet on hover; dark or light parchment, after the app
